avis.titre: Cica is the way to go!
avis.texte: I was kindly sent this product in exchange for my honest opinion. As someone who deals with mild acne, redness, and irritation, I love cica products to help combat these issues because of the soothing properties. Needless to say I was excited to try this product, and it didn't disappoint. I love that this can be used as a spot treatment or applied all over the face, which is fantastic for both my acne and any post-dermaplane irritation I may experience. The formula has a nice consistency and a clean cica smell which is pleasant, and the packaging makes it easy to apply. I apply it at night, and by morning most of the redness, swelling, and irritation is gone and my blemishes are noticeably smaller. While it isn't going to get rid of your acne overnight, I certainly saw a difference with regular use. Once I finish this, I will actually be purchasing a new tube because it actually works for my skincare needs!

I absolutely love how well this product works for my breakouts. I've been using it in the evenings as part of my routine, and when I wake up, my acne is noticeably less red and much less irritated than the night before. I'll definitely continue using this product and plan to repurchase.

I've been using the SKIN1004 Tea-Trica Spot Cream for about a week now, and it honestly works really well. It's lightweight, not drying, and calms down active acne and redness fast. My whiteheads and small pimples look flatter by the next morning, and it doesn't irritate my skin at all. Super gentle but effective, definitely a new go-to spot treatment.

avis.titre: Calm and soothing on skin, would repurchase
avis.texte: ​I received this product for review, but I've spent my own money on other products from this line before, so I already had high hopes. ​My skin is combo with an oily t-zone and dryness everywhere else, so spot treatments usually just end up making me peel. This one was different. It's gentle and didn't irritate my skin or leave me with those dry, flaky patches that usually come with acne creams. I find that the cream also doesn't just sit on the skin, but does sink into the skin. This is where I docked a star though, because while I like that it does sink into the skin, it sort of defeats the purpose of it being a concentrated spot treatment. ​I don't get a ton of breakouts, so I don't reach for a spot treatment every single day, but it's been a great option to have on hand. If you have mild to moderate acne and want something that won't wreck your skin barrier, it's definitely worth a look. The only thing I'd flag is the size; the tube is pretty small, so if you're dealing with more frequent breakouts and using it constantly, it might not be the most cost-effective option in the long run. But for occasional use, It's a solid option.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again for my blemishes!
avis.texte: I received this product for free to review. I often get blemishes on my face and am acne prone. This cream is cooling and helps reduce redness pretty quickly after a few uses. Would recommend for those who have sensitive skin!

I'm really impressed with this spot cream. It's gentle but effective, and I noticed a visible reduction in redness and inflammation within a short time. It absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue, which makes it easy to use both day and night. I also appreciate that it doesn't overly dry out my skin like many spot treatments do. Overall, it's a reliable product for calming breakouts and helping spots heal faster. I'll definitely continue using it and would recommend it to anyone dealing with occasional blemishes.

I used this product when I had a few flare ups and by morning it dried out my inflamed spots! Over night!! I don't know if I would use this every night but it is definitely something I would use when I have any spots or inflammation flare ups on my face! I also love this brand and I trust it very much!

I absolutely love this product for acne and marks. It works well and quickly, noticing results only a few weeks of using. It also is great for the winter as it hydrates your skin. I absolutely love the tea tree oil scent

This spot treatment is unusual in that it focuses more on fighting irritation and inflammation versus clearing the pore. It feels lightly hydrating and absorbs fast, though I like to massage spot treatments in for around 15 seconds to make sure it really sinks in. The ingredients, especially panthenol, are excellent at calming and protecting skin, which is definitely helpful during a breakout. I used this spot treatment on a number of pimples and noticed the biggest difference on ones that had come to a head or were already drying out. It seemed to really speed along the healing process and made my acne less visible by reducing redness and inflammation. I didn't experience any dryness or flakiness though with how gentle these ingredients are that didn't really surprise me. Unfortunately, this spot treatment didn't do much for deep or emerging pimples. It wasn't strong enough to clear blocked pores and was really only effective on "mature" or very mild acne. If you struggle mainly with cysts, this isn't the spot treatment for you!

I used the cream for 2 weeks and noticed a difference in the redness of my skin. It really reduced it. The cream is smooth and works well under makeup. I have combination skin and it did not cause any issues. It did not dry my skin or over moisturize it. If you are looking to decrease redness and something to help with some acne, I highly recommend this.
This product help reduce the pigmentation i have from a sun spot, now its easier to cover with my foundation. Also love the smell of the cream and its very smooth and gentle. Will totally recommend.

I was gifted the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica Spot Cream from BzzAgent and it really lives up to its reputation. It's lightweight, absorbs quickly, and helps calm redness while reducing the size of blemishes without irritating my skin. I've only been using it for a week, so it's still too early to know the long-term results, but so far the short-term improvements have been promising.

avis.titre: Great for mild acne & sensitive skin!
avis.texte: I really like the formula and the smell is similar to tea tree oil. It's not overly drying. Although, it may be better for more mild-acne proned skin.

avis.titre: This product is suitable for dark spots.
avis.texte: I've been using this product and I like it. It's easy to use, the amount of cream is just right for dry skin, and it slightly fades dark spots. This product brightens the skin, and I like the tea scent; it's soothing and relaxing.

This product is a decent size for a spot treatment that can also be used all over the face. I appreciate that the smell is not overwhelming like other tea tree products. I think the fact that it has AHA in it should be more obviously stated. I would prefer a product with just tea tree oil or just AHA rather than both. I have not experienced any irritation but I have been quite cautious since I use a prescription topical every other night.

avis.titre: Saved My Red, Painful Skin in Hours
avis.texte: I received this product for free from Skin1004 for testing and review purposes. I received this just in time for when my skin barrier was severely damaged from a chemical peel I decided to try. My cheeks were tomato-red, scaly, and extremely painful. Applying anything, even gentle skincare, hurt. As soon as I applied this cream, I felt an immediate cooling sensation, and the pain instantly eased enough for me to layer other products on top. Within a few hours, the redness had noticeably gone down, and I actually felt comfortable enough to go outside without feeling self-conscious. The texture is very lightweight and watery, so it spreads easily and layers beautifully without feeling heavy at all. Overall, this was a huge relief when my skin needed it most.
This is a really great spot cream! The cream is hydrating, smooth texture, light weight and the tea tree smell is not overpowering.

I received this product complimentary in exchange for my honest review. I cannot be certain that this product or time is the reason my acne has gone down, but it has seemed to speed things up. I have used it for a week and noticed a reduction of redness and swelling. I will continue to use it as I think it's helping

I received Tea-Trica Spot Cream for testing purposes and here is what I have experienced in the past few weeks. After trying this spot correcter cream, my skin shows little improvement. Best part is the application of cream does not feel heavy and has no weird smell.

I noticed a dramatic difference in the overall irritation and appearance of any blemishes. It goes on smooth and has a refreshing scent and is not overly drying with all natural tea tree to fight bacteria. A life saver!
The product feels great on the skin! I feel it has a cooling sensation when applied which I enjoy! Overall great product!

I was super impressed with the reduction in red from my acne on my nose! I was not expecting that at all. It worked really well on the spots on my cheeks, clearing them faster than the patches I used.

Skin1004 kindly gave me this tea trica spot cream for free so that I could review it. This product effectively improved my acne and decreased associated redness. I applied this product twice daily over a few zits on my cheek and forehead; over a few day period, the zit on my forehead completely disappeared while the zit on my cheek significantly diminished in size and redness. I was not left with my typical post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation or skin texture changes from the acne. This product offers a mild, but inoffensive, scent and is not too sticky on the skin. Overall, I would definitely recommend this product and will continue to use it!
